prompts.portraits:
Use case: stylized-concept / character redesign. Create ONE transparent character sheet showing TWO distinctive older Korean shopping-game characters full-body, FRONT VIEW, man on the LEFT and woman on the RIGHT. Two equal portrait columns, generous transparent gap, same head scale and shoe baseline. References 1 and 2 are CLOTHING AND PIXEL-TECHNIQUE REFERENCES ONLY. Keep their blue and pink striped tracksuits, off-white trainers and OPEN-TOP sports sun visors, and their warm simple pixel-art rendering, but COMPLETELY REDESIGN THEIR FACE SHAPES AND EXPRESSIONS. Do not preserve their cute generic big square eyes, identical rounded cheeks, button noses or easy smile. The user explicitly rejected those generic faces.
ART DIRECTION: two comic 'penny-pinchers', shrewd bargain hunters who meticulously count every small saving; memorable, slightly stubborn and crafty, humorous rather than evil or hostile. Their personality must be communicated by FACE GEOMETRY, eyebrows, small eyes, nose and mouth, not by money props, text or symbols.
LEFT MAN (blue): age about 60; a longer angular rectangular face, pronounced cheek planes, lean lower cheeks, firm square chin, small broad flat nose. Narrow horizontal squinting eyes under thick low-set salt-and-pepper eyebrows; one brow a touch lifted as if doubting a price. Lips tightly pressed into a short slightly off-center line with only a tiny satisfied corner, no open smile. Two modest creases beside the mouth and restrained crow's feet. Short brushed-back gray hair with charcoal at temples, exposed above an ivory sun visor with navy band. Clearly an alert, obstinate, thrifty older man, NOT an angry villain, NOT a big-eyed child.
RIGHT WOMAN (pink): age about 60; a compact pear-shaped face with broad upper cheekbones tapering to a pointed little chin, clearly different silhouette from the man's long square face. Small narrow almond-shaped eyes, one sharply arched eyebrow, subtle sideways knowing look, pursed thin lips with ONE corner curled into a sly restrained smirk. Small rounded projecting nose, light laugh lines, short wavy silver-gray bob framing the cheeks. Ivory open-top sun visor with dusty-pink band; gray hair visible above it. She looks clever, strong-willed and exacting about prices, NOT sweetly blank, NOT a copy of the man.
Bodies: compact existing-game chibi proportions about 2.8 heads tall, relaxed straight-on standing with arms at sides and EMPTY hands. Blue/pink zip-up tracksuits with no hoods and thin off-white sleeve/leg stripes. No outfit redesign, no props, no wallets, no coins, no glasses, no beards, no labels. The key difference is distinctive mature angular face design and small expressive eyes.
MEDIUM: warm Korean 2D pixel-game illustration, consistent stepped dark outlines, broad limited color clusters, simple restrained 2-3-tone shadows, deliberately low-detail readable faces at small scale. No smooth vector, no 3D, no painterly detail, no portrait realism, no shiny huge pupils, no large round blush disks. Both complete full-body figures visible with clear 6% outer margin. Actual transparent alpha background, no floor, shadow, grid, labels, checkerboard, scene or any third character.
prompts.maleSheet:
Use case: identity-preserve. Make ONE transparent horizontal SPRITE SHEET containing EXACTLY THREE animation frames of ONLY the BLUE-TRACKSUIT MAN on the LEFT in the supplied TWO-character design sheet. Do NOT include the other character. The supplied sheet is the final face design: preserve this specific older 'penny-pincher' character's identity, gray hair, open-top ivory sun visor, colored visor band, tracksuit, white stripes, white sneakers, proportions and rendering. In particular keep his angular square-jawed lean face, small horizontal half-lidded eye, low thick gray eyebrow, wide flat nose, closed tight asymmetric mouth and restrained cheek creases. Do NOT revert to the earlier sweet generic round-faced large-eyed campfire style. Expression stays shrewd, calculating and comically thrifty in all three frames, never changes to cheerful baby smile.
Canvas: wide landscape 3:1 ratio, THREE identical square cells in ONE ROW. Strict RIGHT-facing SIDE VIEW in all frames, one complete full-body character per cell. Both arms outstretched comfortably forward at chest level, farther arm slightly above nearer so both hands can be seen. Only the hands change:
1 LEFT: two open palms, fingers fully extended.
2 CENTER: fingers of both hands half-curled, loose C shapes.
3 RIGHT: BOTH hands fully closed as compact fists, thumbs covering folded fingers.
Identical head, visor, body, shoulders, wrists, legs and feet and EXACT SAME positioning/scale/pixel density across three frames. The visor's open top reveals gray hair; its short curved brim projects forwards over the eyes. Body center 40% of each cell, fingertips inside 85%; 7% top and bottom margin, transparent gutters, all feet same baseline and all crowns same height. Three poses generated together as one coherent sheet. No jumping, punching, walking, throwing, bending torso or elbows. Repeat the first body in every frame with only finger shape changing.
Use the reference's warm simple 2D pixel game art with dark stepped outlines, broad flat color blocks and restrained shadows. Actual transparent alpha background throughout. NO glow, no vignette, no shadows around sprites, no backdrop, ground, props, other people, title, numbering, dividers, boxes, grid or checkerboard. All hair and shoes completely visible. Exactly 3 side-facing poses of the male, not 2 or 4.
